text:
maria_cs: :wave: Hey team — kicking off onboarding for Galactic Insights (Bob is on the thread). Goal: align stakeholders, define 30/60/90 success criteria, surface any renewal risks early, and schedule enablement. Who should own each piece?

sam_ae: Adding customer context — Bob signed a 6mo pilot w/ potential expansion. Main goals are latency <200ms for search responses and embedding accuracy for semantic search. Renewal signal tied to hit rate on top-10 queries.

bob_gi: Thanks Sam + Maria. Confirming we have dev access to their API and sample dataset ready. We'd like a demo by end of week of week 1. Also concerned about data residency for EU users.

jay_ce: I can own technical onboarding (integration + infra). Plan: initial env validation (day 1-2), ingest pipeline test (day 3-7), end-to-end demo (day 7). Need access to S3 creds and an account with Redwood Private staging.

ana_prod: Quick note on success criteria — recommend 3 measurable metrics: 1) 95th pct latency <=200ms under baseline load, 2) Top-10 retrieval precision >=0.72 on their eval set, 3) <=2% error rate on inference calls. Those map to renewal/kpi.

maria_cs: Agreed on metrics. I'll capture them in the success playbook and share a short checklist. Proposal for owners:
- Stakeholder lead: sam_ae
- CS owner (onboarding + health): maria_cs
- Tech owner: jay_ce
- Product validation: ana_prod
- Ops/security & data residency: tom_ops

bob_gi: That split works. For data residency: all EU data must stay in EU region; can you confirm Redwood Private staging supports that?

tom_ops: We have a EU Private deployment option. I'll confirm KMS/HSM key requirements and create a one-pager on audit logs + retention. Potential risk: if customer needs on-prem we may need 2–3 week lead time. Flagging as a timeline risk to watch.

maria_cs: Helpful — tom, please add lead time into the timeline. I propose a 30/60/90 with milestones:
- Week 1 (30): env validation, sample ingest, demo, enablement session #1 (product walkthrough)
- Week 2-4 (60): performance tuning, cache/batch config, quantization suggestions from runtime team, docs handoff
- Week 5-12 (90): scale tests, SLA baseline, training for ops, go/no-go for production rollout

sam_ae: Also we should lock a renewal checkpoint at day 60 — if we hit the three success metrics by then we trigger commercial expansion discussion. If not, we need a remediation plan.

calendar-bot: Created event "Galactic Insights Onboard: Week 1 demo" for May 14 10:00-11:00 (UTC). Invite: maria_cs, sam_ae, jay_ce, ana_prod, tom_ops, bob_gi.

maria_cs: Nice — I'll send a short pre-demo checklist to Bob (required creds, test queries, sample size).

bob_gi: I'll get the dataset and creds over by EOD tomorrow. Quick Q: can we get a sandbox with token-level cost breakdown per route? That helps us forecast usage.

ana_prod: Yes — we can expose per-route token metrics in the Console. Jay, can you add a dashboard card for their top-3 routes?

jay_ce: Yup — will add a quick dashboard. Also adding a note: plan to enable prefix KV caching for common prompts to reduce token spend and improve latency. Will demo config impact during week 2.

maria_cs: Two risks captured so far: 1) data residency / on-prem lead time (owner: tom_ops), 2) commercial renewal at day 60 (owner: sam_ae). Any other risks?

bob_gi: Resource risk on our side — only one engineer allocated for integration. Could slow us down. I can try to free up another engineer if needed.

maria_cs: Noted. Action items:
- tom_ops: confirm EU KMS details + lead times (due: +3 business days)
- jay_ce: env validation checklist + dashboard card (due: demo)
- ana_prod: prepare eval pass/fail script and expected thresholds (due: day 7)
- sam_ae: prepare renewal checkpoint terms and commercial trigger (due: day 45)
- bob_gi: share creds and sample dataset (due: EOD tomorrow)
- maria_cs: assemble success playbook + weekly health check template (due: before demo)

maria_cs: I'll update the playbook PR and ping the thread when it's ready. Anyone want to add items or push back on owners/timeline?

sam_ae: Looks good from AE side. Keeping an eye on expansion motion.

bob_gi: All good. Appreciate the clear milestones.

maria_cs: Great — closing for now. Will post the playbook link in the thread soon. :thumbsup:
